name: @kaaloo/context-bump
description: Automatically raises the context window and max output tokens for hosted Letta model conversations, applying targets from the squad-mods shared memory repository at both agent and conversation scope.
author: Luis Arias

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:bundle: bun build mods/index.ts --target node --outfile /tmp/context-bump-bundle-drift-check.mjs && cmp -s /tmp/context-bump-bundle-drift-check.mjs mods/index.bundled.mjs && echo 'bundle matches source' || (echo 'BUNDLE DRIFT: mods/index.bundled.mjs does not match source — run npm run build and commit the bundle' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: npm run verify:bundle && npm run typecheck && npm run test
